configuration.purpose: Separate window production from convolution engines, flatten pixel/fold loops into oneII1 loop and shift fixed channel registers each fold. Register balanced fabric reductions to break E070's eight-DSP unregistered adder path. Online padding caches the first row and reads/emits subsequent rows together, avoiding pad3's serialized row phases.

purpose_section:
Separate window production from convolution engines, flatten pixel/fold loops into oneII1 loop and shift fixed channel registers each fold. Register balanced fabric reductions to break E070's eight-DSP unregistered adder path. Online padding caches the first row and reads/emits subsequent rows together, avoiding pad3's serialized row phases.
